serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The HealthVerity Privacy Preserving Record Linkage identity management solution is the leading SaaS solution that de-identifies and matches individuals at scale in a privacy-protecting fashion across multiple datasets with the highest level of accuracy. It acts as an honest broker service that permits centralized de-identified linkage of individual person-level records across systems, organizations, and settings over time. HealthVerity technology supports key applications that require the ability to create a unique anonymized identifier that can unify data across source systems while meeting privacy standards such as HIPAA. The solution can be implemented using either batch processing or real-time API-enabled record linkage to support multi-party data integration needs for applications and analytics.
